shard.title: Subject: Women
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

name: fepriest
label: R favors women as priests

questions.text:
A. IF CATHOLIC RESPONDENT, ASK FEPRIEST. OTHERS GO TO FECLERGY.
As I read this statement, will you tell me whether you agree strongly, agree somewhat, disagree somewhat, or disagree strongly? 
It would be a good thing if women were allowed to be ordained as priests.

name: feclergy
label: R favors women as ministers

questions.text:
B. ASK NON-CATHOLICS ONLY. 
Do you favor or oppose women as pastors, ministers, priests, or rabbis in your own faith or denomination?

name: fehome
label: Women take care of home not country

questions.text: Do you agree or disagree with this statement?  Women should take care of running their homes and leave running the country up to men.

name: fework
label: Should women work

questions.text: Do you approve or disapprove of a married woman earning money in business or industry if she has a husband capable of supporting her?

name: fepres
label: Vote for woman president

questions.text: If your party nominated a woman for President, would you vote for her if she were qualified for the job?

name: fepol
label: Women not suited for politics

questions.text: A. Tell me if you agree or disagree with this statement:  Most men are better suited emotionally for politics than are most women.

name: fepoly
label: Men or women better suited for politics

questions.text: B. Would you say that most men are better suited emotionally for politics than are most women, that men and women are equally suited, or that women are better suited than men in this area?

name: feimp
label: Importance of women's rights issue to R

questions.text: A. How important is the women's rights issue to you--would you say it is one of the most important, important, not very important, or not important at all?

name: feinfo
label: How much info R has on women's rgts

questions.text: B. How much information do you have about the women's rights issue? Do you have all of the information you need, most of the information, some information, or very little information?

name: fefirm
label: How firm Is R's opinion on women's rghts

questions.text: C. How firm are you about your opinion on women's rights--would you say you are very likely to change your opinion, somewhat likely to change, somewhat unlikely to change, or very unlikely to change?

name: fecare
label: R's concern about women's rights

questions.text: A. How concerned are you personally about women's rights?  Are you very concerned somewhat concerned, not very concerned, or not concerned at all?

A. A working mother can establish just as warm and secure a relationship with her children as a mother who does not work.

questions.item: A. A working mother can establish just as warm and secure a relationship with her children as a mother who does not work.

label: Salience, women's rights

questions.text:
How often would you say that you and your friends think about topics we've been discussing during the interview? would you say that you and your friends think about (READ EACH ITEM A-E) very often, sometimes, or almost never?
A. Women's rights

name: feinflu
label: Opinion of political influence of women

questions.text: People have different opinions about the amount of influence that various groups have in American life and politics. Do you think that women have far too much influence, too much influence, about the right amount of influence, too little influence, or do they have far too little influence?

name: fegains
label: Best way for women to improve position

questions.text: People have different ideas about the best way for women to improve their position in American life and politics. Some people think that the best way for women to improve their position is through women's rights groups, they would be at point 1 on this card. Other people think that the best way for women to improve their position is for each individual women to become better trained and more qualified. They would be located at point 7. And other people have opinions somewhere in between. Where would you place yourself on this scale?

name: sexpromo
label: Sex makes your promotion different

questions.text: Do you think your being a (man/woman) makes your promotion opportunities better or worse?

name: fejobaff
label: For or against preferential hiring of women

questions.text:
Some people say that because of past discrimination, women should be given preference in hiring and promotion. Others say that such preference in hiring and promotion of women is wrong because it discriminates against men. What about your opinion - are you for or against preferential hiring and promotion of women?
IF FOR:Do you favor preference in hiring and promotion strongly or not strongly?
IF AGAINST:Do you oppose preference in hiring and promotion strongly or not strongly?

label: A man won't get a job or promotion

questions.text: A. What do you think the chances are these days that a man won't get a job or promotion while an equally or less qualified woman gets one instead? Is this very likely, somewhat likely, somewhat unlikely, or very unlikely these days?

questions.text: B. What do you think the chances are these days that a woman won't get a job or promotion while an equally or less qualified man gets one instead? Is this very likely, somewhat likely, somewhat unlikely, or very unlikely these days?

name: womenben
label: Women benefit from traditional family

questions.text:
In many married couples, women take the main responsibility for the care of the home and children, while men take the main responsibility for supporting the family financially. Who benefits from this: men, women, children, everyone, or no one? PROBE: Anyone else? UNTIL R SAYS NO.
B. Women
